Releases Regular Weekly Net Asset Value and Year-To-Date Return As Of 27 October 2026 Pershing Square Holdings, Ltd. (LN:PSH) (LN:PSHD) today released its regular weekly Net Asset Value (“NAV”) and performance returns on its website, https://pershingsquareholdings.com/performance/net-asset-value-and-returns/ . The NAV and returns were computed as of the close of business on Tuesday, 27 October 2026. PSH NAV per share as of close of business on 27 October 2026 was 77.95 USD / 58.54 GBP and year-to-date performance was -8.0%. Weekly net asset value (“NAV”) is calculated as of the close of business on each Tuesday and posted on the following business day. In the event that Tuesday is not a business day, the Company will calculate the close-of-business NAV as of the business day immediately preceding that Tuesday. The end-of-month NAV is calculated as of the close of business on the last day of the month and posted on the following business day. For weeks that include a month-end NAV report, PSH will provide only the month-end NAV and not report the Tuesday NAV. Monthly NAVs are published in accordance with the Decree on Conduct of Business Supervision of Financial Undertakings under the Wft (Besluit Gedragstoezicht financiële ondernemingen Wft). Performance is presented on a net-of-fees basis and reflects the deduction of, among other expenses: management fees, brokerage commissions, administrative fees and accrued performance fees, if any. The performance figure includes the reinvestment of all dividends, interest and capital gains. Depending on the timing of a specific investment, net performance for an individual investor may vary from the net performance as stated herein. Net performance is a geometrically linked time weighted calculation. Past performance is not necessarily indicative of future results. All investments involve risk including the loss of principal. Volta Finance Limited Net Asset Value(s) as at 30 September 2026 | Company Announcement | Investegate Welcome Articles About Contact Us Help Home Companies Advanced search Archive Meetings UK Newswire New Login Register Volta Finance Limited Net Asset Value(s) as at 30 September 2026 Volta Finance Limited Net Asset Value(s) as at 30 September 2026 Volta Finance Limited (VTA / VTAS) September 2026 monthly report NOT FOR RELEASE, DISTRIBUTION, OR PUBLICATION, IN WHOLE OR PART, IN OR INTO THE UNITED STATES Guernsey, 29 th October 2026 BNPP AM has published the Volta Finance Limited (the “Company” or “Volta Finance” or “Volta”) monthly report for September 2026. The full report is attached to this release and will be available on Volta’s website shortly ( www.voltafinance.com ). Performance and Portfolio Activity Dear Investors, Volta Finance posted a net return of -0.4% for the month of September 2026. For comparison, both US and Euro High Yield markets were down over the same period, respectively -2.5% & -1.8% ****, while the Morningstar Leveraged Loan indices returned +0.2%*** in the US and +0.3%**** in Europe. September was dominated by a sharp repricing of inflation and policy expectations as higher oil prices and renewed Middle East tensions pushed markets into a more volatile, headline-driven environment. Early hopes that moderating inflation might allow the Federal Reserve to remain on hold gave way to a more hawkish backdrop after stronger US inflation-related data and a renewed surge in energy prices. The ECB raised its deposit rate by 25bp and maintained a hawkish, data-dependent stance, while the Fed delivered its first-rate hike since 2023 and left the door open to further tightening. Government bond yields moved materially higher over the month, with long-dated US Treasury yields reaching multi-year highs, as investors absorbed a higher-for-longer rates outlook alongside persistent inflation risks. Although resilient growth and solid corporate earnings continued to provide some support, tighter financial conditions, elevated rate volatility and geopolitical uncertainty made for a more selective risk environment by month-end. Against that backdrop, credit markets remained relatively orderly despite the rates shock, with spreads widening only modestly even as broader risk sentiment weakened. Credit resilience stood in contrast to the significant volatility in government bonds and equities, but the combination of higher real yields, rising funding costs and renewed inflation concerns increasingly weighed on valuations and reinforced the need for selectivity across risk assets. For structured credit, the month was therefore characterised less by fundamental credit deterioration than by the interaction between persistent macro resilience, higher energy-driven inflation risk and a more restrictive policy outlook. We purchased EUR 7.3 million across three European single-B rated CLO tranches at discount margins of approximately 1,000 bps, as well as three minority CLO equity positions following the decrease in loans price. Volta is also a minority equity investor in a CLO that was reset during the period. We elected to contribute our pro rata share of the additional equity required for the transaction, while securing a 10 bps management fee rebate on the newly injected equity. From a positioning perspective, we continue to scrutinize the market for opportunistic CLO equity investment while maintaining a greater allocation to mezzanine CLO tranches given the current level of market uncertainty. We also remain highly selective in terms of collateral manager selection. At the end of September 2026, the Fund held approximately EUR 33.4 million in cash and cash equivalents, providing capacity to deploy capital should attractive opportunities emerge during periods of market volatility.
